meet.v_slow: Slower than we'd like. That may be down to your connection or your device. We're showing it as it is anyway.
meet.v_cache: You already had these files. Almost nothing had to come over the network again.
meet.v_bf: You came back using the back button. Your browser showed the page from its memory.

meet.foot: Measured in your own browser, using the metrics Google uses for speed and stability (Core Web Vitals). Nothing is sent to us or to anyone else. A different device or connection gives different figures. The thresholds come from Google (web.dev).

items.q: How much does a website from you cost?
items.a: There's no separate price tag. Your website is included in Digital Growth: €150 per month, cancellable monthly. That also covers your Google profile, review requests, your CRM and online payments.

items.q: How soon will my site be online?
Can customers book and pay online?
items.a: Yes. The appointment planner and lead forms are built in. Payments go through Stripe, with Bancontact, iDEAL, Visa or Apple Pay.

items.q: Does it come with a chatbot?
items.a: Not as standard. The AI chatbot is an add-on for €50 per month. Want someone to answer your phone too? That's the AI receptionist, for €125 per month.

items.q: Will I be at the top of Google?
items.a: Nobody can honestly promise that. We build your site fast and SEO-ready, and we fill in your Google profile completely and keep it up to date.
We do. We build and manage your entire digital operation, and your website is part of that.
